placement: Beside the entrance to Cole's quarters, 365 cm east and 340 cm south of the hut centre, fitted to the woodland terrain

implementation.art: Irregular bark-covered stump, root flare, radial end grain, cracks, oval hickory handle and beveled steel axe head
implementation.interaction: E extracts the axe; LMB or RT swings without throwing; E returns it when aiming at the nearby stump, otherwise sets it down
implementation.effects: Chops leave marks and kick up short-lived wood chips with an impact sound
implementation.damage: Close-range, server-authoritative point damage integrates with existing props and reactive trees
implementation.recovery: An axe lost below terrain or outside the playable bounds returns to the stump without duplication

checks: Exactly one grounded stump and one axe, with only the cutting tip inserted 1.5 cm
Forged head clears the top by 1.9 cm; handle grip is 64.1 cm above the top
One-handed grip on the wooden handle, not the head
Axe remains within the playable view and follows the carry target
Repeated clicks respect swing cooldown and do not throw the axe
Stump receives a chop with marks, chips and thud playback
Return to stump releases the grip and parks the same axe
Second pickup after returning the axe
Ordinary interactive props receive real axe damage
A missed swing does not damage distant objects
Set-down enables gravity/collision and clears the reservation
Actual character movement through the clearing, porch steps and hut doorway
runtime_review.visual_review: Placement, handle grip, chopping, re-embedded axe and ground placement screenshots inspected
limitations: Audio playback was invoked but not separately recorded

protected: Existing hut, sign, woodland trail and trees retained
Existing basketball and other furniture controls retained
No house-map asset rewrite or user-save modification
Unrelated dirty files and open editor preserved
latest_change: Reoriented the parked axe so the head and handle stick up above the stump, while only the sharpened corner seats in the wood. Applies to initial placement, return-to-stump and recovery.
preview: Updated placement and interaction checks used an isolated UserDir; open editors need restarting to load the rebuilt module
